editor_action: When a whistle blows with no obvious collision, new viewers need to know why the ball changed hands: immediately trigger a brief scoreboard note explaining the rule that was broken ('3-Second Violation: Offensive player stood in the painted lane >3s', '5-Second Violation: Took >5s to pass the ball inbounds', or '10-Second Backcourt Violation').
timing_constraint: Flash the plain-English rule explanation pill on the scoreboard during the 3-second turnover handoff (Execute within <= 1.0s reaction window and return to CAM-1 before live ball.)
plain_english_tip: 10-Second Backcourt: The offense has 10 seconds to dribble across the center line and cannot pass back behind it once across.

title: Zone vs. Man-To-Man Tactical Switch Explainer
trigger_condition: Macro game pattern when a team switches from man-to-man defense (guarding a specific person) to a zone defense (guarding an area of the floor) after a timeout.
editor_action: Hold CAM-1 (Main Wide) Wide slightly zoomed out on the first possession in zone defense and trigger a brief scoreboard note ('2-3 Zone Defense') so viewers can see the five defenders aligned in a formation.
timing_constraint: Hold wide CAM-1 and show tactical label on the first possession after a defensive scheme switch (example: 5.0s pill).

title: 5-Second Closely Guarded Violation (Holding or Dribbling Trap)
trigger_condition: A defender guards an offensive player within 6 feet for 5 continuous seconds without the player passing or shooting, triggering a turnover whistle.
editor_action: Cut to the celebratory defender and bench on CAM-3 (Player Close-Up)/CAM-4 (Coach & Bench) and flash a scoreboard note ('5-Second Closely Guarded Turnover: Defensive Trap').
timing_constraint: 3.0s celebration + rule note during the side-out handoff.

title: Free-Throw Lane Violation ('Stepping into The Paint Too Early')
trigger_condition: A rebounder steps across the painted lane line before the free-throw shooter releases the ball, or the shooter steps over the free-throw line before the ball hits the rim.
editor_action: Roll a quick CAM-1 (Main Wide)/CAM-2 (Baseline Low) replay showing the player's foot crossing the line early and explain whether the shooter gets a re-shot (defensive violation) or loses the point (offensive violation).
timing_constraint: Quick 3.0s lane-violation explanation before the next play or re-shot.
plain_english_tip: The Paint: The rectangular lane under the hoop where inside scorers battle (offensive players cannot camp inside it for >3 seconds).

title: Offense-For-Defense Late-Game Substitution Pattern
trigger_condition: In the final 2 minutes of a close game, a coach repeatedly substitutes a tall defender in on defense and a 3-point shooter in on offense during every whistle.
editor_action: Highlight the strategic chess match by showing the players checking in at the scorer's table on CAM-4 (Coach & Bench) with a 'Situational Sub: Offense vs. Defense' note.
timing_constraint: Brief 2.5s dead-ball check-in during late-game substitution whistles.
plain_english_tip: 3-Pointer: Any shot released from behind the large painted arc counts for 3 points instead of 2.

title: Shot-Clock Malfunction / Horn Horn Inadvertent Whistle Reset
trigger_condition: The scorer's table horn sounds accidentally or a shot clock malfunctions during live play, forcing referees to blow an inadvertent whistle.
editor_action: Keep CAM-1 (Main Wide)/CAM-4 (Coach & Bench) on the referees consulting the scorer's table and display 'Clock Reset / Inadvertent Whistle' so viewers know why play paused without a foul.
timing_constraint: Hold during the scorer's table clock correction pause.
plain_english_tip: Two Clocks: Teams have 30 seconds on the shot clock to hit the rim on each possession while the 20-minute half clock counts down.

title: Substitution Wave vs. Free-Throw Shooter Focus
trigger_condition: Multiple substitutes check into the game between the first and second free throws while the shooter waits at the line. (Visual cue: Two or three players jogging onto the court from the scorer's table; Audio cue: Horn sounds and announcer lists the new lineup on the floor.)
editor_action: If a star player is checking back into the game, give the Substitution shot 2 to 3 seconds of camera priority before cutting back to the free-throw shooter; if it is a routine bench rotation, keep the camera on the shooter and display the substitutions via a compact scorebug ticker (example: Star Sub = camera cut; Routine Sub = graphic ticker). Recommended framing: Bench / Table Medium (CAM-4, Coach & Bench) -> Main Sideline (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Always return to CAM-1 (Main Wide) before the referee hands the ball to the free-throw shooter.
plain_english_tip: Free Throw: An unguarded 1-point penalty shot from 15 feet while the game clock is stopped.

title: Sponsor 'Game Flow' or 'Play of The Game' Feature Slot
trigger_condition: Returning from the final Under-4 media timeout of the second half (~3:30 remaining). (Visual cue: Branded replay frame showcasing the most athletic dunk or clutch play of the night; Audio cue: Play-by-play announcer reading the brief 'Play of the Game' sponsor tag.)
editor_action: Air the signature 'Play of the Game' slow-motion replay package coming out of the final Under-4 media timeout while teams are still walking onto the floor, wrapping up before the referee hands the ball to the inbounder (example: ~6-8s feature replay before live play). Recommended framing: High-Frame-Rate Replay (CAM-3 (Player Close-Up) / CAM-5 (Above-Rim)) -> Main Sideline (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Target window: ~6-8s feature replay before live play. Cut out of the feature immediately if the ball is put into play early.
plain_english_tip: Dunk & Block: Slamming the ball directly through the rim, or leaping to swat an opponent's shot away.

title: Half-By-Half & Segment Scoring Table on Second-Half Returns
trigger_condition: Returning from a timeout in the second half after a team has mounted a dominant scoring surge. (Visual cue: Line-score table showing 1ST HALF | 2ND HALF | TOTAL points for both teams; Audio cue: Commentator pointing out how one team has outscored the other 24-10 since halftime.)
editor_action: Show the half-by-half scoring breakdown table coming out of a timeout so viewers can see at a glance how the second half shifted the game's outcome (example: ~5s half line-score lower-third). Recommended framing: Main Sideline (CAM-1, Main Wide) with Half Breakdown Graphic.
timing_constraint: Target window: ~5s half line-score lower-third. Highlight the active second-half scoring differential in bold color.

title: Basketball Occluded Behind Near-Sideline Coach or Ref
trigger_condition: A player dribbles along the near-side sideline right in front of a standing head coach or sideline referee, briefly hiding the basketball from CAM-1 (Main Wide). (Visual cue: Standing coach or official in the foreground of CAM-1 (Main Wide) intersecting the ball-handler; Audio cue: Live play-by-play narration.)
editor_action: Maintain steady framing on CAM-1 (Main Wide) (do not panic-cut to a tight baseline camera) as the ball-handler dribbles past the brief 0.5-second foreground obstruction, because all 9 other players and the court context remain visible (example: hold CAM-1 (Main Wide) through transient < 1.0s foreground pass-by). Recommended framing: Main Sideline Camera (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Only switch to a higher angle if the foreground obstruction persists for more than 1.5 seconds in a stationary corner trap.

title: Late Second-Half Blowout Storytelling Pivot (Bench Reserves & Next Game)
trigger_condition: A team leads by 22 or more points in the final 4 minutes of the second half, and both coaches empty their benches. (Visual cue: Star players sitting relaxed on the bench in warmups while young reserve players take the court; Audio cue: Commentators reflecting on the overall season picture and upcoming schedule.)
editor_action: When the game outcome is decided in the final minutes of a blowout, allow slightly longer dead-ball looks at the smiling stars on the bench, full-game statistical summaries, and upcoming schedule graphics while still keeping CAM-1 (Main Wide) active for the reserves' live play (example: relaxed dead-ball storytelling when margin >= 20 in final 4 minutes). Recommended framing: Main Sideline (CAM-1, Main Wide) + Resting Stars (CAM-4, Coach & Bench).
timing_constraint: Target window: relaxed dead-ball storytelling when margin >= 20 in final 4 minutes. Still celebrate big baskets by young bench players with proper close-up reactions.

title: Late Substitution Identity Resolution via Jersey Ocr
trigger_condition: A player enters the game quickly at the horn without the official play-by-play feed logging the substitution yet, and immediately makes a basket. (Visual cue: Newly entered player scoring before the stat feed updates their on-court status; Audio cue: Announcer calls the scorer by name and jersey number.)
editor_action: Cross-check the visible jersey number on CAM-3 (Player Close-Up) and the announcer's spoken name against the team roster so the correct player is credited on the post-score close-up even if the official substitution API lags by a few seconds (example: visual jersey + roster lookup fallback). Recommended framing: Tight Hero Close-Up (CAM-3, Player Close-Up).
timing_constraint: If the jersey number is obscured, show the close-up without a name banner rather than guessing the wrong teammate (Trigger safe-harbor fallback to CAM-1 Wide within < 0.5s of confidence drop.)
plain_english_tip: Two Clocks: Teams have 30 seconds on the shot clock to hit the rim on each possession while the 20-minute half clock counts down.

title: Arena Lighting Show / Blackout Pre-Game & Timeout Adaptation
trigger_condition: The home arena dims its main bowl lights for theatrical player introductions or a late second-half timeout light show. (Visual cue: Drastic drop in ambient arena lighting with spotlights sweeping the court; Audio cue: High-energy arena PA hype music.)
editor_action: Adjust camera iris/exposure smoothly for darkened arena light shows during stoppages and ensure exposure returns to standard broadcast brightness before the arena court lights come back to 100% for live play (example: auto-iris ramp clamped to prevent whiteout flash when court lights turn back on). Recommended framing: Main Sideline (CAM-1, Main Wide) or Spotlight Hero (CAM-3, Player Close-Up).
timing_constraint: Never cut to an unlit dark corner camera during a theatrical blackout (Trigger safe-harbor fallback to CAM-1 Wide within < 0.5s of confidence drop.)

title: Home Arena Entertainment / Mascot / Fan Vignette Usage
trigger_condition: During a dead-ball return when players are slow to walk out of the huddle and no urgent tactical replay is pending. (Visual cue: Arena mascot, pep band, or energetic student section; Audio cue: Lighthearted commentary remark as the broadcast returns from break.)
editor_action: Use a brief 3-second local pep band, mascot, or student-section vignette only as a warm atmospheric opener coming out of a commercial break in the opening 32 minutes of play, cutting to the court well before the ball is live (example: <= 3.0s arena flavor shot before players take the floor). Recommended framing: Baseline / Crowd (CAM-2, Baseline Low) -> Main Sideline (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Target window: <= 3.0s arena flavor shot before players take the floor. Skip lighthearted mascot or crowd vignettes when returning to a tense final-4-minute clutch situation.
plain_english_tip: The Paint: The rectangular lane under the hoop where inside scorers battle (offensive players cannot camp inside it for >3 seconds).

title: Double Dribble & Carrying/palming Violation Explanation
trigger_condition: A referee blows the whistle and rotates both hands or flips their palm to signal a double-dribble or carrying turnover.
editor_action: Show the referee's hand signal on CAM-1 (Main Wide)/CAM-3 (Player Close-Up) and flash a brief scoreboard note ('Double Dribble Turnover: Stopped Dribbling and Dribbled Again').
timing_constraint: 3.0s scoreboard turnover note during the side-out throw-in.

title: Wedgie / Held Ball on The Rim (Possession Arrow Trigger)
trigger_condition: A shot gets wedged tightly between the orange rim and the backboard ('wedgie'), stopping play.
editor_action: Show the ball stuck on the rim on CAM-2 (Baseline Low)/CAM-5, then flash the 'Possession Arrow' indicator on the scoreboard explaining which team receives the ball.
timing_constraint: Show rim close-up + possession arrow explanation during the retrieval pause (example: 4.0s).

title: Second-Half Tournament Bracket & Upcoming Schedule Read Window
trigger_condition: A dead-ball pause or free-throw setup shortly after the first media timeout of the 2nd Half.
editor_action: Provide a clean 8-to-10 second graphic card showing the tournament bracket or next scheduled games while keeping the live court visible on CAM-1 (Main Wide) so the announcer can update viewers on what is at stake without missing live action.
timing_constraint: Air once per game during a 2nd-Half dead-ball pause (example: 8s compact promo/bracket card).
plain_english_tip: Free Throw: An unguarded 1-point penalty shot from 15 feet while the game clock is stopped.
